title: CISA Adds Active GitLab and Cisco Flaws to KEV List
excerpt: CISA has added two actively exploited vulnerabilities affecting Cisco and GitLab software to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
body_html:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency has updated its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog to include two security flaws impacting GitLab and Cisco software. The addition follows evidence of active exploitation in the wild.

Among the additions is an integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability affecting GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise, designated as CVE-2026-97229, which carries a maximum CVSS score of 10.0.

Federal agencies and organizations are typically required to remediate vulnerabilities added to the catalog within specified timeframes to reduce the risk of active exploitation.
